description: This file is a JavaScript script for running Cypress tests in a CI environment, managing test execution, reporting, and interaction with a test dashboard.

methods.name: runCypressTest
methods.description: Executes Cypress tests with specified spec and configuration, returning the test result.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Saves the test result, updates environment info, and records individual test cases.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Determines if tests should run in headless mode based on environment variable.

methods.name: trimToMaxLength
methods.description: Trims text to a maximum length of 5000 characters.

methods.name: printSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of test statuses grouped by server.

methods.name: runSpecFragment
methods.description: Prepares and runs a test spec, with retry logic for dashboard server errors.

methods.name: runSpec
methods.description: Main function to run all test specs sequentially.
